end.summary:
- Predicted that objects with curved surfaces roll, including a ball, bottle and drum; this was shown on a new-situation question.
- Practised predicting that flat-faced objects slide; responses were partly right and need checking next time.
- Practised predicting that objects with flat tops and bottoms stack; responses were partly right and need checking next time.
- Practised that the same object can roll or stand/stack in different positions; the round-part mix-up was corrected later with a glass example.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting objects by curved and flat surfaces to predict whether they roll, slide or stack. They used the curved side to explain rolling, and later corrected the mix-up that a round-part object cannot stack by describing a glass standing and supporting another object. At home, try a ball, box and glass: ask what each will do in two different positions and ask why.
